cards.front: Anxious-ambivalent attachment develops from [___] caregiving and is characterised by hyperactivation of the attachment system with oscillation between seeking and resisting closeness.
cards.context:
The child becomes preoccupied with caregiver availability, clinging desperately during separations and unable to settle on reunion.

These relational patterns persist into adolescence and adulthood, contributing to personality pathology.

cards.front: Personality traits become a personality disorder when they are enduring, pervasive, and [___], causing significant distress or impairment, with onset in adolescence or early adulthood and stability over time.
cards.context: Personality traits are universal — everyone has characteristic patterns of thinking, feeling, and behaving.
